newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African IN02 bond yield pegged at 15.44 pct.
newsitem.headline: S.African IN02 bond yield pegged at 15.44 pct.

text.p: The Infrastructure Finance Corp's (INCA) IN02 bond due 2006 had been pegged at a 15.44 percent yield and the all in price pegged at 92.94310 rand percent, Msele Corporate and Merchant Bank's Raymond Kruger said on Tuesday.
He said the offer for the 500 million private placement of the IN02 would open at 0700 GMT and close at 1100 GMT on Tuesday.
Results of the offer would be announced by Wednesday 1100 GMT, he said.
The rate on the 200 million rand IN01 2003 bond had been pegged at 15.30 percent, while the yield on the longer dated IN03 2011 bond had been pegged at 15.60 percent, Kruger said.
